remarks: Move in ready! Spacious, sundrenched 4 bedroom, 4 bath home on cul-de-sac sits back on one landscaped acre in sought after "Trails" neighborhood of North Stamford with city water. A peaceful, outdoor oasis just minutes from shops, restaurants, and schools.  Wonderfully maintained and renovated. Bright open floor plan with soaring cathedral ceilings, floor to ceiling windows, beautiful wood floors, and outdoor access to patios and decks throughout.  Updated eat-in kitchen opens to family room with fireplace. Formal dining room, living room with fireplace and four-season sunroom offer wonderful options for entertaining.  Large primary suite with office, sitting area, double walk-in closets and deck. Attached four-car garage. Whole house generator. Close to all of Stamford's amenities as well as Pound Ridge and Bedford.
